caption: The drawing displays three distinct objects on a plain, light beige background. In the upper left, there is an intricate knot design formed from what appears to be braided brown hair, secured with gold-toned accents at each end and a decorative, round gold centerpiece. To its right, another object features a simpler loop of dark brown braided material, possibly hair, crossed over itself and attached with small metallic elements to a straight pin bar. Below these two objects, centered, is a horizontal band of brown braided material, also resembling hair, with ornate gold and black rectangular hardware in the middle. From this central hardware hangs a short chain ending in a small oval pendant with a black-and-white portrait. The words "Westchester County" are written in the lower left of the image, and "Drawn by Wm. P. Shearwood" is written in the lower right. The overall style is precise, with fine details and muted, natural colors of brown, gold, black, and gray.
title: Brooch and Bracelet with Portrait
